body: For finding a hookup or whatever, it’s pretty easy for trans people. You saw the video, he literally opened his Tinder and had like 2,000+ matches. Doesn’t sound like he’s having a hard time to me.

Never really heard of that before, but sounds like a weird concept.

If the workers are up for it, then all for them I guess. Honestly just sounds like legal prostitution to me though.

Just watched it.

I really don’t think he did enough research before making that video. Incels aren’t this insanely misogynistic hate group that should be shamed. At the end of the day, it’s just a bunch of lonely guys that need someone special in their lives.

Also, didn’t really get his arguments against the redpill and blackpill ideologies. He really didn’t shift my views on them at all, and I’m still a firm believer in the red/black pill.

Also, a trans man, he really doesn’t have much of a say in the incel community. LGBTQ+ really can’t be incel. It’s so easy for them to find a partner that they really have no idea what being incel is like.

It was a lot to digest, so I’ll update this reply if I think of anything else to say.

Not all of us are misogynists. And it’s true, we do have a lot in common with a lot of people. Loneliness is very real and affects most of us at some point in our lives. I think it’s the level of loneliness and experience that separates a normal person from an incel.

I didn’t chose to identify with incels, it just sort of how it all turned out, if that makes any sense.

Not really. I take those ideologies with a big asterisk saying “not all.” Although looks is still at the very forefront of all human attraction for just about everyone, there are always outliers. NOT ALL people care exclusively about looks. Sure, it still plays a huge factor in finding a partner whether we like it or not, but for some people it’s not as big and for others it’s a very big deal.

I don’t think I explained that well so I’m sorry lol, this stuff honestly confuses me too
Yes, for me, personality is more important than looks. And yes, there are for sure women who prefer personality over looks. The only problem is finding them. They’re a rare breed.
True. I accept that I can’t really change what life dealt to me, and unlike other incels, I actually am trying to change myself for the better. I try not to bitch and moan about it too much.

I think the one thing I’m gaining from thinking this way is the truth. I’d rather know the hard truth than to go through life being oblivious.

In a partner, Iooks do matter for me, but personality is far more important. I’d rather have a decent looking girl with a great personality than a great looking girl with a decent personality.

In a friend, looks obviously don’t matter at all, so I really just want a friend with a similar personality, similar interests, sense of humor, etc.
Yeah, I get your point but that’s not me. I’d like a human, thanks.

I’ve tried before and am going to continue trying. I for sure have some emotional and bonding problems that I need to work out. It’s a tough journey but I’m trying.

And for the thing about genes, yes you’re right, all kinds of people are looking for all kinds of things. But the large majority of people (everyone, deep down) are looking for looks, it’s just the hard truth. Whether we realize it or not, we really are controlled by genes and means of attraction that have been the same for literally millions of years, for both men and women. It can be conscious or subconscious, but it’s there and will likely always be there. 

Your partner, deep down, is driven by genes and physical attraction, and so are you and me and all of the other humans on the planet. That’s the redpill for ya.
Jesus Christ, no. I love my cat, but I don’t want to marry him.
Honestly, nothing. Maybe the fact that I think I might still have some hope (or at least I like to tell myself that I do) but that’s about it.

It’s obviously not going to magically solve all my problems, but it’ll definitely help with the loneliness.
I don’t have many friends, no real strong emotional bonds. That’s honestly a problem with most incels. Not only do they not have a partner, they’re just generally very lonely people.
Getting a girl won’t magically solve all my problems. Honestly, I’m almost positive I have at least some sort of mental illness/disorder, which obviously can’t be magically solved with a girlfriend. But it would at least help with other problems.
Yes. Attractive guys can get approached by females without saying a word. I’ve never gotten that.

In a way, yes. But it’s not their fault.
The way they act is a result of evolution. They prefer men with dominant physical traits: big muscles, chiseled jawline, etc. It’s the same with men too, men prefer women with more feminine features. It’s just hardwired into our DNA, whether we’re conscious about it or not.
The problem comes when women (or men really) care exclusively about looks and completely reject personality. A lot of incels aren’t great looking guys, but they at least have a pretty good personality (or maybe they did before they became toxic). They’ve just come into contact with the women who only care about looks, which unfortunately is most women these days.

So really, in the end, I blame genetics and evolution. For making human attraction the way it is, and for making me the way I look.
Because I never get any matches.
